requirement: Joomla Apply: no contact record carries the account email; without the owner's mailbox the template's address goes and the form is said to be off

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026: with no email or phone typed, a Joomla site made with Apply kept the demo company's mailbox (sales@northgate-ind.ru) as the contact form's recipient and its telephone on the page (ledger L05, L11). A first fix (4e6ebaa4b) wrote the account email where no switch showed it; review found Joomla 5 publishes email_to anyway (vCard view, contacts finder). Reds 5facff718, 3f576e04f; fixes 4e6ebaa4b, 1bb4cab3f.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 55). Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): with no email typed the template's email_to is emptied whatever the page shows, the Apply report carries the form-off note with no address in it, the account email of the person who pressed Apply is written nowhere, the template's telephone goes when no phone is typed and its mobile and fax always; a typed email and phone still win and a {site.phone} placeholder is left.
